exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.cue: Lower slowly to upper chest, elbows slightly tucked, smooth press.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.cue: Shoulders back, grip slightly wide, squeeze chest at the top.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Lower to chin height, core braced, press with control.

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raises
exercises.cue: Lead with elbows, lift to shoulder height, don't swing.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows locked in, extend fully, pause at bottom.

exercises.name: Overhead Rope Extension
exercises.cue: Stretch behind head, extend straight up, keep back still.

cardio.name: Incline walk intervals - 12 min
cardio.detail: 1 min fast walk (6-6.5 km/h, 8% incline) / 1 min easy (5 km/h, 2%), x6. Walking, not running, to spare the knees.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull elbows down to ribs, chest tall, no momentum.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.cue: Pull to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades, stay supported.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.cue: Sit tall, pull handle to belly button, control the return.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.cue: Arms wide, feel rear delts, don't shrug.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curls
exercises.cue: Elbows by your sides, curl slowly, palms up, full squeeze.

exercises.name: Cable Curls
exercises.cue: Face the stack, elbows pinned, full stretch at bottom, squeeze at top.

cardio.name: Low-impact circuit - 3 rounds
cardio.detail: 30 sec each: step jacks, standing marches, slow mountain climbers, glute bridges, push-ups, plank. No jumping, no deep knee bends. 60 sec rest between rounds.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.cue: Feet higher on the platform, go only as deep as is pain-free, control the descent, don't lock out. Start light.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Feet high on the platform, lower only as far as pain-free (stop short of 90 degrees if needed), no locking out.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Light weight, slow, pain-free range only. Skip it if it hurts the knee.
exercises.flag: KNEE NOTE: light, skip if painful

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
exercises.cue: Hips down, curl smoothly, squeeze at bottom.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch, push through big toe, slow descent.

cardio.name: Cycling - 15-20 min
cardio.detail: Stationary bike, steady moderate effort, seat high enough that the knee is only slightly bent at the bottom.

cardio.name: Walk - hit 10,000 steps
cardio.detail: No gym. An easy 30-45 min walk plus stairs through the day. Light stretching if stiff.

exercises.name: Flat DB Press
exercises.cue: Lower smoothly, elbows tucked, press evenly.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.cue: Slight elbow bend, hands meet at chest height.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
exercises.cue: Pull elbows down and forward, chest stays up.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.cue: Pull to stomach, squeeze mid-back, slow return.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curls
exercises.cue: Elbows still, curl smoothly, full squeeze.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned, spread the rope at the bottom, slow return.

cardio.name: Treadmill brisk walk - 20-30 min
cardio.detail: 5-6 km/h, 2-4% incline. Breathing harder but still able to talk.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Lower to chin height, don't lock elbows, stay braced.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.cue: Lift to shoulder height, soft elbows, slow lower.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (machine or barbell)
exercises.cue: Upper back on the bench, drive through heels, squeeze glutes at the top, shins vertical.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
exercises.cue: Curl smoothly, squeeze hard, control the stretch.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Light weight, slow, pain-free range only. Skip it if it hurts the knee.

cardio.name: Treadmill brisk walk - 20 min
cardio.detail: 5-6 km/h, 2-4% incline. No skipping or jumping while the knee hurts.

cardio.name: Walk - hit 10,000 steps
cardio.detail: Rest day. Easy walk, sleep well, plan the week's meals.
